closure_detail.D-002: Independently re-verified with vision on 03-qr-image-loaded.png (fresh capture) plus a 6x nearest-neighbor crop of the QR region for close inspection. The QR code IS genuinely present, fully in-frame (not clipped on any edge), with three crisp, undistorted finder-pattern squares (top-left, top-right, bottom-left) and a dense, high-contrast black-on-near-white module grid -- no blur, no anti-alias mush, no missing quiet zone. This is a real, well-formed, visually scannable-looking QR code; I would trust it on a real kiosk screen. It sits inside a card next to 'Suivez votre commande' / 'Scannez pour suivre la preparation depuis votre telephone' copy, matching the round-2 GStack self-report. The fix (git show b7435596d) is a real, minimal 8-line diff: `scrollIntoViewIfNeeded()` + a 150ms settle wait inserted immediately before the '03-qr-image-loaded' snap call. The round's central, explicitly-mandated visual-evidence acceptance criterion for the QR is satisfied. NOTE: this fix was scoped narrowly to state 03 only -- see new finding D-101 for the residual (non-blocking, P2) cutoff still present in states 01/02/05 for the position-ahead/almost-ready badge, which round-1's D-002 evidence had also cited but which this round's commit did not address.
